name: Atelier
author: AkiraYuki587
description: Atelier is a Bauhaus Textus theme: primary-color hard stops, bold black outlines, hard shadows and a striped grid, with a conic color wheel and heading gradients. Original palette; the :root:root window-color pin is adapted from Misty (myshzzx / E-Tiger Studio, MIT), with thanks.

zh.description: 格构 Atelier：包豪斯三原色硬切、粗黑描边与硬阴影、45 度重复斜条纹网格，锥形色轮与硬色标渐变标题。原创配色与实现；仅借 Misty（myshzzx 投稿 / E-Tiger Studio / Typora Misty，MIT）的 :root:root 钉色技巧并致谢。单一浅色外观，仅一张渲染预览图。
